NOTE
**Still not ready: the guide's steps are mostly not done yet**

New: Two small pushes (+1 line) and a comment saying tests and linting pass; the commit message is unchanged. Missing: the self-review checklist still has the AI use policy box and "calls out remaining decisions" unchecked, and the description has no manual testing notes or before/after examples of the rendering. The PR also doesn't mention #39598, which is already in maintainer review for the same issue and touches the same two files, and #39881, which overlaps on code block tabs.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to complete the PR template and explain how this relates to #39598 and #39881.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please finish the self-review checklist (including the AI use policy item), describe how you tested this by hand with before/after examples, and say how it relates to #39598 and #39881, following the [guide on submitting a PR](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html).
```
